what_happened.what: Fixed BotPassword grants for Blue Railroad bot release-edit permission. Root cause was that BotPasswords system restricts rights to explicitly granted grants; `release-edit` wasn't mapped to any grant until fixed in LocalSettings.php.
Deployed Release page creation in Blue Railroad Imports bot. Added video player to Release pages with HLS→direct video fallback for raw video files.
Created Special:Releases MediaWiki page with sortable table, i18n fixes, and three editable wikitext slots for header/mid/footer content.
Fixed CIDv1 case sensitivity issue: ipfs.io gateway rejects mixed-case CIDs. Applied strtolower() to gateway URLs.
Debugged HLS video player failure: Blue Railroad videos are raw mp4 files, not HLS streams. Implemented fallback logic in Common.js to try HLS first, then direct video playback.

Continued Star Control 2 game development: fixed 8 ship special abilities (VUX warp-in, Thraddash flame trail, Pkunk resurrection, Chmmr zapsats, Yehat energy-drain shield, Druuge recoil, Orz marines, Utwig absorb), added new weapon types (cone, autoaim), enhanced graphics (particles, weapon effects, artifacts).
Overhauled SC2 music: added 4-voice polyphony with synthesized drum kit, expanded from 5 to 9 tracks, added state-specific music (starbase, orbit, lander, victory).

Added major SC2 gameplay features: fuel range circle on map, detailed planet scan data (gravity/temp/weather/tectonics), 6 lander hazard types, expanded galaxy to ~270 stars, Kohr-Ah FRIED boomerang blade, portrait mouth animations, combat asteroids, escape pods, mineral sparkle effects, radar facing arrows.

Designed multi-step content pipeline architecture: Upload (team/bot/public) → Candidate period (review/edit metadata) → Transcode → Pin → Release page creation. Decided on delivery-kid as staging area, subsequent-to for versioning, Special wiki page for team upload with no auth needed on cryptograss.live.

Built general content draft workflow on delivery-kid pinning service: extended analyze/transcode services for video/audio/images, created /draft-content endpoints alongside existing /draft-album, added HLS transcoding support.

Built Special:UploadContent wiki page: four-step workflow (wallet connect → upload → review → finalize), uses window.ethereum for MetaMask integration, sends wallet-signed requests to delivery-kid, displays SSE progress stream.

Conducted comprehensive audit of Star Control 2 game vs original: confirmed 21 ships implemented with distinct specials, captured core gameplay loop (explore→encounter→dialogue→combat→upgrade), identified missing narrative campaign and specific mechanic refinements needed for full SC2 fidelity.

self_statements.quote: Hmm, that's odd. If the bot has `release` group and the group grants `release-edit`, it shouldn't be denied.
self_statements.context: Struggling with permission model before discovering BotPassword grants system.

self_statements.quote: **There it is.** The bot password `@importer` has a **restricted set of rights** — `release-edit` is NOT in the list. BotPasswords in MediaWiki let you grant a subset of the parent account's rights.
self_statements.context: Breakthrough moment identifying root cause of permission issue.

self_statements.quote: So the bot can create Release pages via the browser (which uses the same `action=edit` API endpoint), but mwclient fails. That really narrows it to something mwclient-specific.
self_statements.context: Narrowing down diagnosis through methodical testing.

self_statements.quote: Alright, big task. The main gaps are: music needs drums and more authentic melodies, HyperSpace needs to be the iconic red void, ships need more detail, combat needs better weapon effects. Let me crank through this.
self_statements.context: Planning music/graphics overhaul for SC2 game.

self_statements.quote: Big update is in. Here's what changed: **Music — 4-voice polyphony now**, 9 tracks instead of 5, drum kit synthesized from noise + oscillators, arpeggio accompaniment layer.

I guess.... in terms of readability of the logic, it does kinda make sense to do the php variant, yeah? Make sure the page links to github, to the php module that's used to render it.

mistakes.what: Initial approach to fix BotPassword grants was incomplete — only added grant definition without mapping it to the bot password.
mistakes.revealed: BotPasswords are a separate system from group permissions; grants must be explicitly enabled on the password object.
mistakes.corrected: Had user enable the release-edit grant on Special:BotPasswords for the @importer bot password, which resolved the permission issue.

mistakes.what: Initially thought video player failing was due to contentmodel parameter, but the real issue was the CID pointing to a raw video file, not an HLS stream.
mistakes.revealed: Not all IPFS video CIDs are HLS-encoded; some are raw mp4 files that need direct playback.
mistakes.corrected: Implemented HLS→direct video fallback in Common.js to handle both HLS and raw video files.

mistakes.what: Tried using `{{Special:PrefixIndex/Release:}}` on Cryptograss:Delivery-kid page, which rendered as a wall of raw CIDs without readability.
mistakes.revealed: Wiki-native transclusion isn't sufficient for user-friendly listing; Special pages with custom rendering are better.
mistakes.corrected: User suggested using Special:Releases (PHP) instead for better readability, updated page to link to it with GitHub source.

corrections_received.guidance: 'It has both' — corrected assumption that bot might not have both release group and exempt-from-verification permissions. Bot did have both; issue was elsewhere (BotPassword grants).
Pushed back on wiki-native (PrefixIndex) approach, suggested PHP Special page instead for better readability and linking to source code.
Requested 'every detail identical to star control 2' — implicit direction to audit and fix all SC2 deviations rather than just add new features.

philosophy.summary: Jenkins uses 'no-touch policy' for deploy — code changes require Ansible playbook to pip reinstall into container, not manual updates.
philosophy.quote: The pip package hasn't been updated on Jenkins. The merge to `main` on GitHub is done, but the Ansible playbook needs to run to actually `pip install --force-reinstall` the new version into the container.

philosophy.summary: BotPasswords restrict rights to explicitly granted grants, separate from parent account rights. This is a critical detail in MediaWiki's auth model.
philosophy.quote: The `@importer` bot password doesn't have `release-edit` because it wasn't mapped to any grant until now.

philosophy.topic: Architecture: delivery-kid as staging, wiki as auth boundary
philosophy.summary: The content pipeline divides responsibilities: delivery-kid handles bytes/transcoding/staging; wiki handles metadata/review/auth boundary. This separates concerns cleanly.
philosophy.quote: delivery-kid is the natural home for the bytes and transcoding, and the wiki is the natural home for metadata and review workflow.

philosophy.summary: Making a game 'identical' to SC2 requires systematic auditing of all systems, not just feature-adding. Small details (particle effects, weapon trails, voice synthesis) accumulate into felt authenticity.
philosophy.quote: The main gaps are: music needs drums and more authentic melodies, HyperSpace needs to be the iconic red void, ships need more detail, combat needs better weapon effects.

The work involved systematic problem-solving (narrow BotPassword grant issue through elimination), collaborative design (being redirected from wiki-native to Special pages), and working across multiple codebases (PickiPedia extensions, Blue Railroad imports, delivery-kid pinning service). Parallel to that, magent continued enhancing a Star Control 2 browser game with increasing fidelity to the original — adding ship specials, music tracks, visual effects, and galaxy-scale features — responding to explicit requests for 'idantucl' (identical) reproduction of SC2. The slice shows magent at its best: methodical debugging, architectural thinking across systems, and responsiveness to user feedback.
